meta.source: github.com/max-SS/cyberpunk themes/*.json (VS Code / Visual Studio Cyberpunk theme by Max)

tokens.name: surface-editor
tokens.usage: Main canvas: page and editor background (VS Code editor.background). Default ground for ink, primary and syntax colors.

tokens.name: surface-sidebar
tokens.usage: Side panels, inactive tabs and tab strips (sideBar.background, tab.inactiveBackground).

tokens.name: surface-deep
tokens.usage: Title bar, current-line highlight, list hover and the deepest wells (titleBar.activeBackground).

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Bottom panels and peek views (panel.background).

tokens.name: surface-console
tokens.usage: Translucent console glass for status bar, hover and suggest widgets, notifications (statusBar.background).

tokens.name: surface-input
tokens.usage: Text inputs and dropdowns (input.background).

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered tab or row (tab.hoverBackground). UMBRA defines none and inherits the Cyberpunk value.

tokens.name: surface-selection
tokens.usage: Selected text and active match (editor.selectionBackground).

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers between side bar, activity bar and editor (sideBar.border).

tokens.name: border-tab
tokens.usage: Borders between tabs (tab.border).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Default foreground on every surface (foreground).

tokens.name: ink-sidebar
tokens.usage: Labels and file names in side panels on surface-sidebar (sideBar.foreground). 4.8:1 Cyberpunk, 6.0:1 UMBRA; SCARLET reaches 4.25:1 (source value kept).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Inactive tab labels and secondary text (tab.inactiveForeground). Reads at 4.5:1 on surface-deep in every protocol; on surface-sidebar it reaches only 3.1–4.4:1 (source pair kept): use there for non-essential labels at 13px+.

tokens.name: ink-line-number
tokens.usage: Gutter line numbers on surface-editor (editorLineNumber.foreground). Decorative only: 4.1:1 Cyberpunk, 3.7:1 UMBRA, 1.9:1 SCARLET, as in the source.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The signature neon: editor text, status bar text, active tab label, focused borders (editor.foreground). Reads on every surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Activity icons, active line number, indent guide (activityBar.foreground).

tokens.name: accent-violet
tokens.usage: Tab hover underline and violet structure (tab.hoverBorder). UMBRA inherits Cyberpunk.

tokens.name: hot-pink
tokens.usage: Progress bars and loud highlights (progressBar.background); the Slack palette's mention color.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: 1px border of inputs and dropdowns, and the focus ring (input.border).

tokens.name: input-ink
tokens.usage: Typed text inside inputs on surface-input (input.foreground).

tokens.name: input-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text in inputs (input.placeholderForeground). 3.6–4.5:1 on surface-input (source value kept): never carry instructions in placeholder text alone.

tokens.name: cursor
tokens.usage: Caret and terminal cursor (editorCursor.foreground).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Hovered/pressed primary button fill (button.hoverBackground); identical in all three protocols.

tokens.name: action-rest
tokens.usage: Resting primary button fill: 65% neon over the ground (button.background).

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on action and action-rest fills (button.foreground).

tokens.name: badge
tokens.usage: Count badges (badge.background).

tokens.name: on-badge
tokens.usage: Number on a badge (badge.foreground).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links (textLink.foreground). SCARLET reads 14:1; Cyberpunk 4.3:1 and UMBRA 3.7:1 on surface-editor, so always underline links.

tokens.name: link-active
tokens.usage: Hovered/active link (textLink.activeForeground).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info borders and modified-file marks (inputValidation.infoBorder).

tokens.name: info-surface
tokens.usage: Info message fill (inputValidation.infoBackground).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning borders (inputValidation.warningBorder).

tokens.name: warning-surface
tokens.usage: Warning message fill (inputValidation.warningBackground).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error borders, deleted files, bracket match (inputValidation.errorBorder).

tokens.name: danger-surface
tokens.usage: Error message fill (inputValidation.errorBackground).

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Error text on dark surfaces (errorForeground). 4.4:1 on the Cyberpunk editor (source value kept): set error messages 14px+ or on danger-surface with ink.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Added/untracked marks (gitDecoration.untrackedResourceForeground). Pair with a +/word: green vs danger is hue-only.

tokens.name: conflict
tokens.usage: Merge conflicts and uncommitted marks (gitDecoration.conflictingResourceForeground).

tokens.name: debug
tokens.usage: Debug-mode status text (statusBar.debuggingForeground).

tokens.name: syntax-comment
tokens.usage: Comments, italic (comment). 3.1–3.7:1 on surface-editor by design (receding comments, source value kept); not for UI text.

tokens.name: syntax-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords, storage, modifiers (keyword, storage.type).

tokens.name: syntax-function
tokens.usage: Functions, calls, operators and punctuation (entity.name.function, keyword.control).

tokens.name: syntax-method
tokens.usage: Class methods and constructors, italic (entity.name.method).

tokens.name: syntax-tag
tokens.usage: HTML tags, units, this/self (entity.name.tag, variable.language).

tokens.name: syntax-number
tokens.usage: Numbers, constants, parameters (constant.numeric, variable.parameter).

tokens.name: syntax-string
tokens.usage: Strings, symbols, inherited classes (string).

tokens.name: syntax-class
tokens.usage: Class names and support types (entity.name, support.class).

tokens.name: syntax-attribute
tokens.usage: Attribute names (entity.other.attribute-name).

tokens.name: syntax-variable
tokens.usage: Variables and plain identifiers (variable).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Editor and code blocks: Fira Code with ligatures on, line height 30 (the theme's recommended settings).

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: Inline code, terminal output, status-bar items.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Labels, lists, menus, buttons (VS Code's 13px UI size).

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Button labels and section headers in side panels (uppercase, 0.5px tracking).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Control padding, gaps inside tab strips and status bars.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel and widget padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gaps between sections.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Panels, tabs, status bar: the editor chrome is square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, badges' corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Count badges (half their 22px height).

tokens.name: shadow-widget
tokens.usage: Floating hover, suggest and notification widgets (widget.shadow).

tokens.name: glow-primary
tokens.usage: Neon glow on focused or hovered primary elements, echoing the logo's glow. Use sparingly.
